ui.purpose: Controls, rows and labels; the minimum for anything read or pressed.

figure.purpose: Scores, GB, percentages, tokens per second, model tags.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Floating things only: toasts, menus, the minimized run bar.

shadows.name: winner-frame
shadows.purpose: The winner's portrait; the one glow in the product.

components.name: Gold Button
components.description: The next step. At most one per screen, none during a running show.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; font: 700 14px/1.2 "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; background: #efbc5a; border: 1px solid #efbc5a; color: #241808; } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #95b46a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background: #f5ca72; border-color: #f5ca72; }

components.name: Line Button
components.css: .ds-btn-line { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; font: 700 14px/1.2 "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #6d5f78; color: #fff9ef; } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #95b46a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-line:hover { background: rgba(255,249,239,0.07); border-color: #f0e7dc; }

components.name: Link Button
components.css: .ds-btn-link { min-height: 24px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: #fff9ef; font: 700 14px/1.2 "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #6d5f78; text-underline-offset: 3px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-link:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-btn-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #95b46a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions: red outline and text, never a fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; font: 700 14px/1.2 "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #ff9278; color: #ff9278; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #95b46a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: rgba(255,146,120,0.12); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: One choice among a few; the chosen one is outlined in the accent.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #6d5f78; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #fff9ef; font: 400 14px/1.2 "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: rgba(255,249,239,0.07); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { border: 2px solid #e37185; padding: 0 13px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #e37185 16%, transparent); font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #95b46a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Row
components.description: Lists are rows with hairlines, figures in mono.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #3b3349; color: #f0e7dc; font: 400 14px/1.4 "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-fig { color: #fff9ef; font: 500 14px/1 "Spline Sans Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; }

components.name: Contestant Portrait
components.description: A portrait with its name and state on the stage.
components.css: .ds-portrait { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 6px; margin: 0; } .ds-face { width: 88px; height: 88px; border-radius: 12px; background: #2e2740; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #e37185; } .ds-portrait strong { color: #fff9ef; font: 400 19px/1.2 "Young Serif", Georgia, serif; } .ds-portrait span { color: #e37185; font: 700 14px/1.2 "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
RigMatch looks like a daytime television studio built in 1974 and running ever since: lit, warm and slightly worn. The 2026-10 redesign, "Call sheet", kept that world and took the costume off everything that is not the show. The stage, the host, the marquee bulbs and the reveal are allowed to be theatrical. Everything you read, pick or compare is set like a production's call sheet: plain rows, sentence case, one obvious next step.

The system holds one tension: **theatre frames, data leads.** The show is the container. The moment a number appears, it is plain, mono and exact, because the product is a claim that these measurements can be trusted. When the show and the data disagree about a pixel, the data wins. When the show and getting the job done disagree, the job wins: the audience is mostly newcomers, and a screen they can follow beats a screen that performs.
keyCharacteristics: Warm dark rooms only. Five themes change the surfaces, the divider line and the accent; gold, green and red are the same in every one.
Gold is the winner and the single next action. A screen has at most one gold button, and a running show has none.
Three typefaces with fixed jobs: Young Serif for what the show says, Atkinson Hyperlegible for what you read or press, Spline Sans Mono for figures.
Sentence case everywhere. No uppercase labels.
Lists are rows with hairlines, not stacks of cards.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: At most one gold button on a screen. If two things want to be gold, one of them is not the next step.

rules.name: The Plain Figure Rule
rules.body: No colour, glow or badge behind a figure. Figures are mono, `--text-strong`, on a plain surface.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, buttons and headings are in sentence case. A word in capitals is shouting at a newcomer.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: If it does not float above the page, it casts no shadow.

dos: Give each screen one gold button, for the next step.
Set figures in Spline Sans Mono on a plain surface.
Use rows for lists and a single panel to lift something off the page.
Write labels in sentence case, in words a newcomer would use.
Check text contrast in all five themes, at the worst point of any gradient behind it.
Keep the stage theatrical and everything else plain.
donts: Put two gold buttons on a screen, or any gold on a running show.
Draw a fixed setting as a chip or pill.
Use uppercase labels, or text under 14px that someone has to read.
Nest a panel in a panel, or give a resting surface a shadow.
Add a glow, badge or colour behind a figure.
